notes.title: He who fights, still lives.
notes.content: [p][b]Hello, everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you very much to those who have shown interest in Aboard the Adventure. I know I'm not the best communicator, but I'll be more active here to keep you informed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The important stuff:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]NO, the game is not canceled.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Yes, its development will be paused. [/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The reason is simple: I need to support myself and my family while I work on it. In addition, I improved as an artist over time, and many aspects of Aboard no longer satisfied me, so I decided to restart its development one last time, with updated graphics and mechanics. [/p][p]The good news In the meantime, I'm working on a smaller project: Night of the Wolves, set on Halloween 1982. I already have most of it figured out (settings, characters, story, puzzles), the idea is that this game will help me finance Aboard. [/p][p]I'm not going to give any dates yet, but I'll let you know when I have important news. [/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support. Being a solodev is a journey of constant learning, and my goal remains to deliver the best game possible. [/p][p]As compensation I leave a preview of the new graphics of Aboard the Adventure:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247294/1a7020003977450501db3ad4d9a84b2f82db458a.png"][/img][/p][p]We'll be in touch![/p][p]Emilio.[/p]

notes.title: Aboard the Adventure definitive demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247294/34c0cf990ab4b0f315332b41aa12f1011d2dc78f.png[/img]

The [b]definitive[/b] demo of Aboard the Adventure has arrived, with corrections in the German translation, some gameplay stuff and the possibility to mute the voice track.

PS: This time the demo [u]is going to stay uploaded[/u], I didn't know that if I removed it from the store those who had downloaded it would not be able to play it anymore. Sorry :P

------------------------------

La demo [b]definitiva[/b] de Aboard the Adventure ya llegó, con correcciones en la traducción al alemán, algunas cosas de jugabilidad y la posibilidad de silenciar la pista de doblaje.

PD: Esta vez la demo [u]va a quedar subida[/u], no sabía que si la retiraba del store quienes la habían descargado ya no podrían jugarla. Perdón :P

notes.content:
